error.syntax: Enter 3–4 octal digits or a 9-character mode
error.symbolic: s/S applies to owner or group, t/T to others
meaning: r read · w write · x execute (search for directories)
special.setuid: setuid (4000): runs as the file owner
special.setgid: setgid (2000): runs as the file group; new directory entries inherit it
special.sticky: sticky (1000): only an entry's owner can delete or rename it
special.case: Lowercase includes execute, uppercase does not
